items.title: crm
items.description: Comp AI CRM is an open source, CRM designed for AI agents. Agentic-first CRM.
items.summary: Comp AI CRM is an open-source, agentic-first CRM designed for AI agents. It is MIT licensed and built using next, eve, and context. It actively manages customer data and automates follow-ups.

items.title: kimi-k3-in-c
items.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
items.summary: Kimi K3 is a 2.78-trillion-parameter language model running inference on a single CPU with 8 GB RAM, using portable C99 without any frameworks or GPUs. It demonstrates efficient use of resources.

items.title: genoffice
items.description: An AI-native office suite for macOS and Windows: word processor, spreadsheet, presentations, and PDF.
items.summary: GenOffice is a free, ad-free AI-native office suite for macOS and Windows, featuring word processor, spreadsheet, presentation, and PDF tools. It is open-source and integrates AI for enhanced productivity. Available for download.

items.title: anatomy
items.description: An interactive 3D human anatomy explorer built using threejs with GPT 5.6 Sol
items.summary: An interactive 3D human anatomy explorer was built using threejs and GPT 5.6 Sol. It's available on GitHub and praised for its educational value. I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon.

items.title: human-writing
items.description: 让 AI 写的中文读起来像一个具体的人在说话。通用创作与改稿 Skill，开箱即用。
items.summary: This AI system was built by a team of inventors at Amazon to assist with human-like writing and reducing AI-generated text traces. It focuses on making text sound more natural and person-like without altering facts or introducing new information.

items.title: open-kimi-ppt-skill
items.description: 非官方 Kimi Slides Skill：让 AI Agent 生成可编辑 PPTD + PPTX，并附带本地浏览器编辑器 Unofficial Kimi Slides skill for AI agents — generate editable PPTD + PPTX with a local browser editor
items.summary: The unofficial Kimi Slides skill generates editable PPTD and PPTX files with a local browser editor. It offers flexibility for different presentation tasks. It can be customized to fit specific presentation needs.

items.title: RealReplicaBench
items.description: RealReplicaBench: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Agents in High-Fidelity, Stateful, and Reproducible Replicas of Real Online Services
items.summary: RealReplicaBench is a benchmark for long-horizon agents in commerce workflows, developed by Alibaba's Accio team. It includes 107 tasks and is dual-licensed under Apache-2.0 and CC BY 4.0. Use it to evaluate and collaborate on agent performance.

items.title: awesome-growth-hacking-skills
items.description: Find agentic growth hacking skills for Claude, ChatGPT, Manus | by enso.bot
items.summary: I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon. Agentic growth hacking uses AI agents to help companies grow across digital platforms. This approach automates and optimizes growth strategies.

items.title: finger-frame-effect-ai
items.summary: The finger-frame effect uses AI to generate a stylized world within a finger frame in a video. It tracks hand gestures and composites the AI-generated video. The effect is available via a GitHub repository and an Instagram post.

items.title: humanizer-cli
items.description: 33 ways to spot AI-written text, right in your terminal. Before/after examples, draft checker, zero dependencies.
items.summary: Humanizer-cli offers 33 methods to identify AI-written text in terminal. It includes before/after examples and a draft checker. It requires no dependencies.

items.title: doc7
items.description: Turn documents into AI-ready Markdown with visual understanding
items.summary: Doc7 converts documents into AI-ready Markdown with visual understanding. Monkt transforms various document formats into AI-ready Markdown or structured JSON. AI-ready knowledge is structured content optimized for AI models, converted to clean markdown.

items.title: awesome-free-ai-course-notes
items.description: A curated collection of machine learning and AI lecture notes from the world's leading universities.  This repository gives you access to the same lecture notes used by students at top institutions such as MIT, helping you learn from the very best educational resources available.
items.summary: Free AI/ML course notes from top universities are available online. Google Cloud offers machine learning and AI courses. Practical deep learning courses are available for free on YouTube.

items.title: super-simple-software-factory
items.description: Repeatable agents-plus-code workflows, packaged as one skill, stamped into any repo. Deterministic Python owns the graph; coding agents are bounded nodes inside it.
items.summary: A super-simple software factory creates repeatable coding agents using deterministic Python, packaged as one skill for any repository. These agents operate as bounded nodes within the graph.

items.title: ratchet
items.description: Your agent reads the rules. This checks whether it followed them.
items.summary: Ratchet is a compliance tool for AI coding agents that enforces rules in real time. It converts suggestions into enforceable limits. It's designed to ensure coding agents follow project guidelines.

items.title: Fuxi
items.description: FuXi is a fast, self-contained AI developer terminal
items.summary: Fuxi is a self-contained AI developer terminal. It is also an AI large model developed by TCL, showcased at the 2025 China Household Appliances and Consumer Electronics Expo.

items.title: HermesOffice
items.description: HermesOffice — AI-native office suite forked from GenOffice (Apache-2.0), with native Hermes Agent AI
items.summary: HermesOffice is an open-source office suite forked from GenOffice, featuring a native AI agent that operates entirely on the user's machine without cloud accounts or third-party proxies. Hermes Agent is an autonomous, open-source AI tool that grows smarter over time.

items.title: LongHorizon-Harness
items.description: The long-horizon computer-use harness. Run AI agents across desktop apps and the CLI for extended periods while preserving task state and making reliable progress on complex workflows. Features fresh-context execution, durable verified state, independent auditing, recoverable progress, and native Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw integration.
items.summary: LongHorizon-Harness manages long-horizon tasks across desktop apps and CLI, preserving state and progress. It integrates with tools like Codex and supports independent auditing. It ensures reliable task execution and progress recovery.

items.title: time-to-first-token
items.description: A 10-week, 30-minutes-a-day roadmap for LLM inference serving and optimization. vLLM, SGLang, quantization, speculative decoding, benchmarking.
items.summary: Time-to-first-token optimization in LLMs uses vLLM, SGLang, and TurboQuant for efficient inference. Quantization and speculative decoding improve performance. Benchmarking shows vLLM and SGLang as top performers.

items.title: agent-vision-toolkit
items.description: 为纯文本模型设计的视觉工具箱和技能——多图理解、图片问答、长图识别、前端 UI 还原、GUI 自动化，并可选无缝接入 Codex、Claude Code、Pi、Oh My Pi、OpenCode ｜ A vision toolkit and skill designed for text-only models — image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, frontend UI restoration, and GUI automation, with optional seamless integration for Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Oh My Pi, and OpenCode
items.summary: Agent-vision-toolkit is a visual tool for text-only models, offering image Q&A, OCR, and GUI automation, with optional integration for Codex and other tools. It supports multimodal models for enhanced visual capabilities.

items.title: InduSecAgent
items.summary: InduSecAgent None refers to Nudge Security's managed agents with built-in governance features. These agents include scoped permissions and risk insights. Start a free trial to manage them.

items.title: qiaomu-seo
items.description: Audit, diagnose, research, plan, implement, experiment on, and verify website SEO across Google, Bing, and AI-search surfaces. Use for technical SEO,
items.summary: To audit SEO across Google, Bing, and AI-search, focus on technical SEO, clean up robots.txt, and optimize for machine crawling. Use tools like Web.dev and AI for insights. Prioritize exact-match relevance and on-page signals for Bing.

items.title: databricks-ai-bootcamp-capstone
items.summary: The Databricks AI Boot Camp capstone involves projects using Databricks, focusing on data pipelines, AI agents, and unstructured data retrieval. The course emphasizes hands-on experience with Databricks tools. The boot camp starts on August 14th.

items.title: JoyAI-Video-Edit
items.description: [Official Repo] JoyAI-Video-Edit: Real-Time Open-Ended Video Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
items.summary: JoyAI-Video-Edit is a real-time video editing framework using autoregressive diffusion. It edits videos continuously without needing the full sequence upfront. It supports diverse instruction-guided edits.

items.title: reflection-engine
items.description: A downloadable prompt that turns your AI assistant's memory of you into a candid, evidence-grounded portrait.
items.summary: Reflection Engine is a prompt tool to help users reflect on AI interactions; it's not an Amazon product. AI introspection tools have limitations. Always consider privacy and data security.

items.title: diri
items.description: Native macOS orchestrator for coding agents — run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and shells in parallel across git worktrees and remote hosts
items.summary: diri is a native macOS app that runs multiple coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and shells in parallel across git worktrees and remote hosts. It offers live status, session persistence, and a menu-bar rollup. It's designed for efficient multitasking in coding projects.

items.title: DeterminFlow
items.description: A production-oriented AI workflow runtime for building, validating, recovering, and shipping complex AI workflows as dependable services. 面向生产的 AI 工作流运行时：快速开发、验证和恢复复杂 AI 工作流，并将其稳定交付为服务。
items.summary: DeterminFlow is a runtime for managing complex AI workflows, ensuring automatic recovery from failures, and facilitating reliable deployment as services. It is open-source and free, requiring users to supply their own LLM API keys. It focuses on reducing the pilot-to-production gap through deterministic workflows.

items.title: wesight-obsidian
items.description: WeSight Obsidian plugin for local agent runtimes.
items.summary: WeSight is an Obsidian plugin for local AI agent runtimes, enabling chat and inline edits without installing CLI tools. It supports local agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. Available on GitHub.

items.title: hbg-classical-poem-silk-video
items.description: Agent Skill for turning Chinese classical poems into vertical Chinese-art videos with ImageGen stills, Docker I2V, calligraphy captions, retained ambience, BGM and final MP4 QA.
items.summary: AI can transform Chinese classical poems into vertical videos with stills, Docker I2V, calligraphy, and music, creating high-quality artistic renditions. This involves advanced models and techniques for generating and refining poetry. The final product is an MP4 file.

items.title: Cambium
items.description: Governance standard and reference toolset for LLM-maintained knowledge corpora
items.summary: Cambium Governance standard focuses on ethical AI use, compliance, and risk management for LLMs. Essential tools include Weaviate and Qdrant for data governance. Effective governance ensures data trustworthiness and compliance.

items.title: TE-Speed-MiniMaxH3-OSS
items.description: MiniMax-H3超级缓存加速插件
items.summary: TE-Speed-MiniMaxH3-OSS is an open-source plugin for caching acceleration. It enhances speed and performance, especially on high-end GPUs like 5090 and 4090. It's recommended for both local and cloud use.

items.title: agent-skills-collection
items.description: Curated collection of modular agent skills for LLM-based agents
items.summary: Agent skills are modular, composable modules for LLM-based agents, enabling specialized task capabilities. They face challenges like skill portability and governance. A benchmark called SkillsBench evaluates their effectiveness.

items.title: nuphus-mcp
items.description: Desktop automation MCP server — computer use for any AI agent: control screen, windows, mouse/keyboard, and Chrome via Model Context Protocol (stdio)
items.summary: The nuphus-mcp Desktop automation server allows AI agents to control mouse, keyboard, and screen via Model Context Protocol. It uses RobotJS for automation and supports Windows OS. Use with caution due to potential risks.

items.title: phoenix
items.description: 不死鸟 Phoenix — Hermes Agent 插件：路由分档/风险防线/自愈/存档点提醒/审批策略自适应，官方钩子接入，不改 Hermes 核心代码
items.summary: Phoenix is a Hermes Agent plugin for modular, non-intrusive enhancements like routing, risk management, and self-healing. It integrates via hooks without altering Hermes core code. Hermes Agent supports various plugin types for custom tools and integrations.

items.title: Qwen-CUA
items.description: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (Almost) Everything — a screenshot-driven agent that operates computers with keyboard and mouse, jointly developed by the Qwen Team and XLang Lab.
items.summary: Qwen-CUA is a computer-use agent that operates through screenshots and native keyboard/mouse inputs, developed by the Qwen Team and XLang Lab. It uses visual context to interact with software without specialized APIs. It demonstrates high performance in various computer-use benchmarks.

items.title: ai-chat-demo
items.summary: AI chat is evolving towards ad-supported models and offers various functionalities like story writing and code generation. Some platforms provide unfiltered, unrestricted chat experiences. DeepAI's AI Chat enhances user context with Pro features.

items.title: moonlit-stories
items.description: Reusable AI English picture-book workflow with consistent illustrations and local Chatterbox TTS.
items.summary: An AI system built by a team at Amazon can create moonlit-stories with reusable workflows for consistent illustrations and local TTS. It uses integrated tools for complete children's book creation.

items.title: dscode
items.description: Coding agent powered by DeepSeek.
items.summary: DeepSeek Coding Agent is an open-source terminal-based AI tool that automates coding tasks and integrates with external services. It gained popularity for its ability to develop full-stack apps without coding. It uses DeepSeek V4 for powerful AI-driven coding assistance.

items.title: gpt-link
items.description: Standalone ChatGPT Session/accessToken link extractor
items.summary: I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon. I provide information without specific affiliations to other projects. For more details, please ask directly related questions.

items.title: bindwidth
items.description: Evidence-aware on-prem LLM inference sizing and TCO calculator
items.summary: Memory bandwidth is crucial for on-prem LLM inference sizing; AMD and NVIDIA hardware offer different performance metrics; use cost calculators for informed decisions.

items.title: literature-review-agent
items.description: A LangGraph-powered agent for literature search, evidence screening, outline generation, and evidence-grounded review writing.
items.summary: LangGraph is a tool for creating stateful, multi-step AI agents. It uses a graph structure to manage tasks like research and summarization. It enables complex workflows through nodes and directed edges.

items.title: hbg-life-simulation
items.description: HBG Agent Skill for Chinese life-simulation narrative videos with consistent comic IP, rapid multi-life openings, Edge TTS, synchronized captions, zoom/pan motion and final MP4 QA.
items.summary: HBG Agent Skill automates Chinese life-simulation videos with rapid multi-life openings, Edge TTS, and synchronized captions. It includes zoom/pan motion and final MP4 QA. The tool ensures consistent comic IP and dynamic narrative elements.

items.title: wai-play
items.description: WAI Play - AI web game testing and quality evaluation platform
items.summary: WAI Play is an AI platform for web game testing and quality evaluation. It uses AI to streamline defect evaluation and improve player experience. It integrates into QA processes to enhance game quality.

items.title: clone-chat
items.description: 用 AI 大模型复刻聊天对象的本地对话 Agent：导入真实聊天记录，LLM 学习 TA 的语气、表情和回复节奏并以人物身份延续对话，支持语音、主动联系与长期记忆，数据全在本地。 | Clone anyone's texting style from real chat history: a local-first LLM agent that learns their tone, stickers and reply rhythm, then chats as them — voice, proactive messages, long-term memory, fully private.
items.summary: AI-driven local agents clone chat styles from real conversations, learning tone and reply patterns, then continue dialogues privately. They support voice, proactive messages, and long-term memory. Data remains locally stored.

items.title: siming
items.description: Behavioral Grammar: detecting adaptive malware via tiny language-model priors and second-order temporal analysis. 0.88M-param self-supervised HIDS — 93% detection vs adaptive adversarial agent at 3.84% onboarding FPR.
items.summary: Behavioral Grammar uses a 0.88M-parameter model to detect adaptive malware with 93% accuracy and 3.84% false-positive rate. It analyzes host behavior as a structured language. The temporal cadence dimension is the strongest discriminator.

items.title: CodePlus
items.description: 探索任务之间如何直接通信、交接并长期协作，同时提供一个真正可用的终端 AI 编程工具。  CodePlus 并不是为了直接复刻 Codex。我希望通过这个项目持续探索新的 Agent 协作方式，同时吸收现有工具中已经得到验证的优秀实践，并逐步把自己的理解变成可以公开、可以使用的技术实现。
items.summary: CodePlus enables direct task communication and long-term collaboration among agents, integrating a terminal AI programming tool for efficient project management and task governance. It supports multiple projects and provides a lightweight code editor.

items.title: odm_AIDataPlatform_demo
items.description: 精简版数据中台demo，仅用于个人技术学习分享，不涉及任何商用数据，已处理脱敏。欢迎各位同事交流学习，点点✨。
items.summary: The odm_AIDataPlatform_demo is a simplified data platform for personal learning, not for commercial use, with de-identified data. It focuses on demonstrating AI capabilities and data management. It's free and designed for initial exploration, not production use.

items.title: gauntlet-loop
items.description: Turn any goal into a short prompt that makes your agent set a real quality bar, run builder and critic pairs, compare blind, and loop until it wins.
items.summary: The gauntlet-loop is a method to improve AI agent performance by splitting goals into parts, building each part, and having separate critics judge against a set bar. It repeats until the goal is met. It doesn't require coding or setup.

items.title: hermes-brasil
items.description: Comunidade brasileira de Hermes Agent (Nous Research) — skills, guias e integrações em português.
items.summary: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI framework by Nous Research with extensive integrations and multilingual support. It has a built-in learning loop and connects to various external systems. The community site hermes-ai.net offers unofficial documentation in multiple languages.

items.title: AgentFlow
items.description: Edge-optimized, containerized machine-learning-integrated workflows converge in a self-healing, autonomous AgentFlow core engine.
items.summary: AgentFlow is a low-code framework for creating AI-powered workflows using natural language and Markdown. It integrates advanced AI models and supports various AI providers. AgentFlow automates complex workflows in regulated industries.

items.title: AgentForge
items.description: Real-time event-driven orchestration of dynamic resource allocation yields a highly scalable, intelligent, and autonomous enterprise agent broker.
items.summary: AgentForge enables real-time orchestration for dynamic resource allocation, creating scalable, intelligent enterprise agents. It uses event-driven architecture for near real-time decision-making. This approach enhances efficiency and autonomy in enterprise operations.
